text:
maria (product): Quick sync — need to lock scope for Private deploy roadmap: VPC/on‑prem packaging, upgrade paths, and customer‑managed networking handshake. Goal: launch readiness criteria by EOD next Tue. Who's in?
devon (eng): in. can we get a short list of must-haves vs nice-to-haves? also need clarity on upgrade model (in-place vs blue/green)
ashley (field-eng): customers we've talked to prefer outbound-only handshake (no inbound ports to their infra). that suggests an egress connector + webhook-style registration. some enterprise customers will insist on inbound reverse-proxy mode though.
kai (solutions): +1 on modes. suggest shipping two network modes: "egress-handshake" and "edge-proxy". document tradeoffs and firewall rules. we could auto-generate ip ranges/terraform snippet for ops.
maria (product): agree. proposed launch must-haves: 1) packaging (deb/rpm + airgap tarball), 2) handshake modes documented + default = egress, 3) automated in-place upgrade with rollback, 4) KMS/HSM key rotation tested, 5) test matrix for common firewall topologies. anything else?
devon (eng): add: integration test harness that exercises KV cache migration and checkpoint resume. rollout tooling: tenant-flag canary + ability to roll back to previous package within 2 mins. we'll need an upgrade-agent daemon that can run offline install; that is more effort but required for air-gapped customers.
ashley (field-eng): customer asks: minimal open ports during upgrade, and a migration window < 30m for small fleets. that's a hard SLO for full DB migrations. can we offer staged rolling upgrade (pods + orchestrator) to meet that for most customers?
maria (product): put staged rolling upgrade in must-have if it helps meet 30m for target customers. otherwise mark as next-phase for large fleets.
kai (solutions): here's a small example of the handshake config we should template for customers:
```
handshake:
  mode: egress-handshake
  outbound:
    url: https://handshake.redwood.example
    port: 443
  proxy_fallback: false
```
and a tenant canary flag payload we plan to use:
```
{
  "tenant_id": "cust-123",
  "feature": "private-upgrade-canary",
  "rollout": 0.05
}
```
devon (eng): build-wise: packaging owners need the exact matrix (os/distros, container runtime, k8s versions). i'll draft a minimal matrix and send today. also we need to define rollback policy: automatic rollback on X% error or manual abort.
maria (product): launch criteria checklist draft: - packaging artifacts produced and verified - network-mode docs + validation scripts - upgrade tool with rollback tested in staging - canary rollout + metrics (error rate, host churn) - security signoff (KMS/HSM) - release notes and runbook. Anyone object?
ashley (field-eng): please add 'customer offline-install runbook' and 'preflight network validator' to the checklist. both are essential for first 3 customers.
oncall-bot: scheduled: private-deploy-roadmap-checkin every Tue 10:00 AM starting next week
maria (product): ok. final ask: devon, can you estimate eng effort for must-haves by Fri? ashley, capture top 5 customer constraints and I will negotiate scope w/ sales. kai, can you mock the terraform/ip output for the egress mode? i'll compile into a single doc.
devon (eng): will do. rough estimate: 4 wks core + 2 wks testing/rollout tooling. may shrink if we reuse existing upgrade-agent code.
ashley (field-eng): i'll pull customer asks and share tomorrow AM.
kai (solutions): will mock terraform snippet and a one-pager for sales by EOD.
maria (product): perfect — thanks team. we'll review estimates Tue and lock M0 scope. :white_check_mark:
